Just wanted to share how to install this plugin via Claude Code Desktop, since the command palette does not include the `/plugin` command and I was unsure whether the cli and the desktop version share the same install system.

1. Click on _customize_
2. Click on the + button at personal plugins
3. Choose create plugin and add marketplace
4. Click Add from repository
5. Enter the github url --> this will show you the available plugins from the repo.

There you go. Hope this helps anyone :)

items.author: akhozya-dojo
items.body:
When running the ponytail extension in the Gemini CLI, the following warning is emitted:

```
⚠  Invalid hook event name: "UserPromptSubmit" from extensions config. Skipping.
```

The Gemini CLI does not recognize the `UserPromptSubmit` hook event defined in `hooks/hooks.json`. This event is specific to Claude Code, causing Gemini CLI to skip it and print a warning on every run.

Consider conditionally configuring hooks based on the CLI environment or wrapping this configuration so Gemini CLI does not complain about invalid hook events.
items.title: Gemini CLI: Invalid hook event name 'UserPromptSubmit' warning
